operation: Use the sifting property of the unit impulse: it is 1 at n=0 and 0 elsewhere
reasoning: The sifting property of the delta function states that Sum(delta[n] * f[n], (n, -oo, oo)) = f[0]. Applying this with f[n] = z**(-n) correctly yields delta[0] * z**(-0), which evaluates the sum at n=0 only.
